verdicts.reason: A inverts the hierarchy: 'Shop the deal' is blown up into a huge three-line stack that outweighs the shrunken 'Buy 1 piece Get 1 free' headline, and the left third of the canvas is dead space. B keeps the headline dominant and reads left to right like a banner should, but the tagline is squeezed into a four-line ragged column, and the CTA rule is stranded about 90 px below 'Shop the deal', so it no longer sits under the text it belongs to.
